motivation.root_cause: Multiple concurrent workers issued GitHub Search and GraphQL screening requests from one account with no machine-wide coordination. Primary quotas were healthy; the burst shape tripped GitHub's dynamic secondary limit. Protocol v1 froze publication pacing and throttle stop behavior but did not govern read-side API traffic shape.
motivation.adversarial_review: Codex adversarial review 2026-07-18 (session 019f75d8-c4da-7d13-b1ba-58a700434c43); all seven findings remediated before this draft.

scope_note: This amendment only adds controls and narrows permitted behavior. Every provision of protocol v1 remains in force unchanged. It judges no previously collected data.

single_gateway.rule: Every GitHub API request from campaign tooling (gh CLI and any api.github.com HTTP) MUST pass through the machine-wide gateway. Exactly one production GitHub spawn site is permitted, inside the gateway module.
single_gateway.git_push_rule: Every outbound git push MUST obtain gateway authorization (hold, breaker, and latch check) immediately before the push and MUST append a content-free ledger event.
recorded_exclusions: read-only git-protocol traffic against public repositories (clone, fetch, pull)
GitHub Pages content polling (*.github.io) at a bounded interval
GH Archive downloads (data.gharchive.org); these never touch the GitHub API

page_bounds.multi_page_broad_sweeps: prohibited (the 500-result multi-page search pattern that caused the incident is disallowed)

daily_budget_aimd.clean_day_definition: UTC day with at least one gateway request and zero throttle detections

terminal_signals: HTTP 403 accompanied by rate-limit or abuse phrasing
exit-zero GraphQL responses whose errors[].type, errors[].code, or errors[].extensions.code is RATE_LIMITED in any casing or separator form
on_detection: no retry at any layer, ever
latch the durable gateway pause (auto_resume false)
trip the persistent phase-0 provider-throttle breaker
raise the PROVIDER_THROTTLED failure class (protocol v1 failure_taxonomy) as a global pipeline hold pending founder review

transient_retry_policy.permitted_only_for: HTTP 5xx and network-level errors (ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, connection reset, service unavailable)

clearance.resume_sequence: clear-hold, then exactly one rate_limit probe through the gateway before any other request

request_accounting.redaction: PR bodies, field payload values, tokens, and credential query parameters never appear in ledger entries

order_of_preference: candidate lake within its 48h freshness window
GH Archive offline mining (zero GitHub API)
live GitHub search as bounded precision top-up under a declared wave budget
discovery_policy.just_in_time_verification: live GitHub checks are reserved for JIT verification of candidates about to be used, via batched GraphQL

gateway_safety_invariants.lock_reclaim_requires: stale heartbeat AND (holder process dead OR process start identity mismatch); reclaim is ledgered and resets pacing

deviations_recorded: Clearances are bound and replay-proof but not cryptographically signed; decision-ID uniqueness plus signal/tripped_at binding covers the replay threat for a founder-local CLI.

The three-record clearance (campaign hold, phase-0 breaker, gateway latch) is mismatch-atomic under the gateway lock but not crash-transactional across its three JSON files; a crash mid-clear leaves a visibly partial state that refuses requests rather than resuming.
Read-only public git traffic and Pages polling intentionally remain outside the gateway; they are not GitHub API traffic.
signing_instructions: Per amendment_control in protocol v1: the founder signs by (1) setting status to signed, (2) setting effective_at to a time at or after signing and before any behavior this amendment governs is relied upon, (3) recording a globally unused founder_decision_id below, (4) computing sha256 over this file with the signature block fields at their pre-signature values and recording it in the founder decision record. No prior data is regraded.
